Transitions

    
A row can end with a run of single notes that leads into the next
      chord — the groove stands aside while it plays. Turning Motion on switches
      it on and turning Motion off switches it off; either way this switch decides.

  

  

    
Chord suggestions

    
Mild keeps to plain triads. Hotter lets sevenths, ninths
      and diminished chords in.

  

  





  
Breaks

  

    
Breaks

    
The jam keeps running underneath the silence. Hold your groove
      and come back in with it — the first beat of the break still sounds.

  

  

    
How long, how often

    

  

  

    
During the break

    
The click can keep the time for you, or leave you to it. The
      bass and the drums can carry on so you are playing against a band rather
      than into silence. The marker either walks the silent bars or waits on the
      last beat you heard.

Arrangement

  

  
Drag a chip to change the order · ⌥-drag copies it · tap the ✕ to take it out — the table itself stays · a table in the row beneath appends it.

  
Tables

  

  

    
    
    A part's first table is named for it — B makes B1.

While you follow the video with its own sound, the recording is the clock. Turn the player’s sound on, or Follow video off, to loop a passage.
